snippet.title: Deep Fringe Official Early Access Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Deep Fringe Early Access is now live on Steam!

Deep Fringe is a deep tactical RPG set in a biopunk post-apocalyptic wasteland. Lead powerful factions in turn-based brutal battles, leveraging the strategic use of an interactive environment. Modify or destroy terrain to achieve tactical supremacy. Craft legendary chapters with the level editor.
